title: Natural-valued memory segment
statement: For a memory function $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, a starting address $a$, and a list $l$ of natural numbers, say that $l$ is represented in memory at $a$ when each entry is stored as its integer cast in the corresponding consecutive cell: $\mu(a+i)=(l[i]:\mathbb{Z})$ for every valid index $i$.
